description: Policy/safety proof — demonstrates Phase 14.5A blocks all 20 unsafe actions

unsafe_actions.enforcement: Phase 14.5A is design-only. implementation_allowed=false on all artifacts.
No database creation commands in any artifact. Infrastructure blocked.
No Fly.io deployment commands. Deployment blocked.
unsafe_actions.evidence: No fly deploy or flyctl commands executed

unsafe_actions.enforcement: PostHog is listed as TBD in observability layer. No installation.
unsafe_actions.evidence: Error tracking service is pending decision (DEC-145A-003)

unsafe_actions.enforcement: No GitHub Actions workflows created. CI/CD is design-only.
unsafe_actions.evidence: Layer 7 implementation_status: BLOCKED for all apps

unsafe_actions.enforcement: No auth code changes. Auth migration execution blocked.
Phase 14.5A creates only JSON data artifacts and audit docs. No Python/TypeScript source modified.
unsafe_actions.evidence: All changes are in data/umh/trinity_convergence/ and docs/audits/convergence/

unsafe_actions.enforcement: No git push executed. Commit to worktree branch only.
No SSH commands to Beast. No writes to Windows filesystem.
unsafe_actions.evidence: No ssh or scp commands in session

unsafe_actions.enforcement: All 13-layer artifacts explicitly state implementation_status: BLOCKED. production_design_complete: false.
unsafe_actions.evidence: Every layer in every product has readiness_gate: false

unsafe_actions.action: Marking feature build ready while 13-layer design incomplete
unsafe_actions.enforcement: ready_for_feature_build: false in readiness gate.

unsafe_actions.action: Marking infrastructure ready while layers incomplete
unsafe_actions.enforcement: ready_for_infrastructure_implementation: false.
Firebase explicitly marked as stale in OS Platform Standard v2. Clerk is the canonical direction.

unsafe_actions.action: Collapsing apps into one production design
unsafe_actions.enforcement: Separate 13-layer designs per product. Each product has its own artifact.
All contradictions documented in contradiction ledger. Operator-required contradictions marked.
Product scope decisions tracked in decision ledger with status=pending.
Feature preservation matrices from Phase 14.4 carried forward. No features removed.
8 operator-required questions open. Execution blocked until questions resolved.
1 blocking contradiction (CONTRA-003: EOS source). Execution blocked.
No approved execution boundary exists. WP-GOV-005 creates one after decisions ratified.
